title: Snapshot statistics, envelopes, empty spatial ECS preparation and manual spatial fragments

environment.note: Development services and other user workloads may be active. No CPU affinity or host isolation.

method.aggregation: Median of three per-run means/percentiles/GC statistics, not a pooled percentile
method.timing: Uninstrumented source, official nengi-buffers writer, counting transport, controlled clock. Step excludes application mutation and spatial-index updates.
method.gc: Node PerformanceObserver GC events during the measured mutation/index/step loop; excludes forced warmup GC and result summarization
method.memory: Heap difference before construction vs after warmup, both after explicit GC; retained memory, not cumulative allocation
method.order: Fresh sequential processes, alternating variant order by case and repeat
method.metrics: Disabled except three named metrics controls. Two named diagnostic controls enable diagnostic binary writes.
method.limits: Not isolated from other host workloads. No sockets, clients, renderer or Jigsaw game loop in timed runs. Small differences may be noise.

source.description: Both variants retain preceding pending membership, allocation, spatial-preparation and client sampling changes. Both use the same extended manual spatial churn harness; the original harness is retained in the archive.

probes.settings: 100 roots, eight users, two setup ticks and one measured tick, broadly overlapping views; automatic/manual/ECS, 2D/3D, shared on/off, idle/active, metrics on/off, plus churn and diagnostic controls
probes.countBoundary: Observed selected construction sites and helper calls/visits; not total allocated bytes
probes.validation: All 80 cases retain identical packet and decoded-state hashes before/after and instrumented/uninstrumented; all 26 timed cases retain bytes per tick and send counts
